## Constraints and accepted decisions

The public results route uses the existing VotePageShell, TenantLogo, ElectionHead, PositionHeader and CandidateAvatar. Colours and fonts come from runtime tenant branding and the existing theme tokens.

The selected direction is Winners first (option 2): elected candidates appear first, with expandable counts for all candidates. Backend winner and cutoff-tie flags determine outcomes. One-seat ties display Tied without Elected; multi-seat cutoff ties retain Elected plus Tied. Voter identity tags are hidden on results pages.

Only published, unarchived elections in the requested active tenant expose results. Visitors need no sign-in. PDF metadata is safe to read; the file and its signed URL are requested only when Download is clicked. The backend renders one compact stored report per publication, with native text and tables, a logo bounded to 192 pixels, and no candidate photographs or voter breakdowns. Results remain available when PDF generation fails.

The user approved implementation in both repositories on 2026-10-13. No deployment is included. Decisions and public 21st reference links are recorded in design.json. The 21st CLI was signed out during exploration; no hosted generation was requested.
